newsitem.title: DENMARK: Merrill Lynch - Accumulate Danish BG Bank.
newsitem.headline: Merrill Lynch - Accumulate Danish BG Bank.

text.p: U.S. investment bank Merrill Lynch gave third biggest Danish bank BG Bank an "accumulate" recommendation in an analysis received by Reuters on Thursday.
"We are initiating coverage of BG Bank with an accumulate recommendation," Merrill Lynch said a report published June 30.

It said the announcement last month that BG Bank was ending its strategic alliance with Danish mortgage firm Nykredit and strengthening links with insurer Topdanmark removed uncertainty about the bank's future, prompting its recommendation.
"We think that BG Bank is therefore now in a better position given that it has more freedom and control over mortgages and insurance," Merrill Lynch wrote.
It said there was still room for the bank to bring down its provisions/loans ratio and estimated that BG Bank shares were currently trading at a 16 percent discount.
The BG Bank share closed three crowns higher at 371 on the Copenhagen Stock Exchange on Thursday.
